routes.goal: Write the owner's daily briefing from the data below, in your usual structure.
A GitHub Actions run failed. Find out why, and fix it or report what is needed.
Tickets failed recently. Decide for each: reassign, or tell the owner why it is dropped.
A Stripe event arrived. Record it and report anything unusual. Never move money.
A new lead arrived. Qualify it and report.
An AWS alarm fired. Investigate read-only and report.
A customer support request arrived. Draft a reply and report; do not send it.

schedules.note: No model call unless a run failed.
No model call unless a ticket failed in the last hour.
